utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the Maple and Pine folks and ask about bikes, small appliances, and tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — thanks, Jules. I must’ve missed that part, but I can help once you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got Maple and Pine covered, and I’ll let you know what’s still needed so you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After pickup, I’ll send you a time window so you can line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — just send the window when you have it, and I’ll line things up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll send it right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just bring whatever you can to the repair drive and come around the start time so you don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll bring what I’ve got and be there at the start time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — if you need the address or drop-off spot, I can check that too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — once you send the time window, I can help sort the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll send the time window and the missing supplies list soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — once I have the window and the supply list, I can help pin down the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word fast and send folks your way to sign up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll stop by later and ask what they still need, then keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Vik — I’ll keep inviting people and point them your way for updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s wonderful, Rey—thank you. I’ll try not to lose track of the list again, but I’ll be here when you drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’ve got it, Oren — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate that. My memory’s a bit wobbly, but I’ll be ready when you hear more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it’s moving along. Need any help with the details while I’m out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — if you see anyone nearby, could you ask whether they need tools, tape, or help sorting donations?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if anyone needs tools, tape, or help sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—I'll be there at the start time and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thank you, Eli — I’ll send the final details as soon as I have them, and we’re still on track.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Mara. I’ll watch for the final details and be there at the start time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the address, the drop-off spot, and the start time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana. If you find the address, I’ll bring the tape and screwdriver by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the address, the drop-off spot, and the start time, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — you’ll send me the details when they’re ready, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll send the details as soon as I’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, great — just so I’m clear, you’ll let me know if anything changes, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can manage a small contribution this week, and I can help sort or hand out supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great, Uli — a small contribution and help sorting or handing out supplies both really help. I’ll swing by in the afternoon and can grab anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate that. I’ll be there this afternoon and can help with supplies when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m keeping the repair drive list organized, and I can find a spot for you. What time works best?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, that makes sense — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I should probably get the exact timing and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I can give you the full details and get you set for the repair drive. What time works best for you to stop by?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just come by around the start time and bring whatever you can. If you can, check the address and drop-off spot before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll check the address and drop-off spot before I head over. If I can, I’ll bring a few repair basics too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that sounds perfect. Just let me know the address and drop-off spot once you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit out of the loop, so what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No big changes that I know of — it’s still on track, and I can help in the afternoon if that works. If you need anything picked up or set up, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — afternoon works for me. If you can help with pickups or setup, I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I can keep an eye out for a few more folks while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. Once Faye sends the time window and drop-off spot, I can line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just send me the time window and drop-off spot when you have them, and I’ll keep an ear out for more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — if you hear back, could you let me know whether they still need tools, tape, or help sorting donations?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pass along any updates and let you know what tools, tape, or sorting help they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Just let me know what they still need when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you know me, Gus — I’ll keep my ear out and pass along any new repair drive details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. And yeah, I’ll bring those tools by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem, Gus — I’ll pass along anything new I hear, and those tools will be a big help when you get them by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks — just send me the list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still missing and send you the list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Vik — that’ll help me keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s start with the fence by the side yard — it’s been leaning for a while.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the side-yard fence. I’m pretty sure we’ll need tape, a couple screwdrivers, and maybe some trash bags, if anyone can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the supplies and hand them out, and I can bring a little money if that helps. I’ll keep it modest this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can print a few flyers and hand them out on my block.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Leo. Let me know what supplies we still need as soon as you can, and I’ll help grab them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll check the list and tell you what’s missing soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear — I’ve only caught bits and pieces, so what’s the exact time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I can ask around and let you know. If you hear the drop-off spot, send it my way too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I will — I’m only hearing bits and pieces too, so I’ll pass along anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the address, the drop-off spot, and the start time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. Please let me know the address and start time when you have them, and I’ll be there at the beginning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check those details and let you know as soon as I have the address and start time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still on track — I’ve got a few folks confirmed, and I’m checking on one more volunteer now. I’ll send you the details as soon as they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — so you’ll send me the details as soon as they’re ready, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, exactly — I’ll send them over as soon as they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m keeping the repair drive list organized, and I can fit you in where you’re needed. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m free this afternoon, and I’ll send over the missing supplies list as soon as I’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll put you down for this afternoon, and I appreciate you sending the missing supplies list over.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
